g.text: Initial cone for a graphical Lagrangian expander
Exact initial gradient cone · this is not the positive-time expander
U₀ = −x₁²/20 + x₂²/4 + 10⁻⁴ x₁⁴/|x|². The small tip is omitted for display.
The theorem constructs the smooth expander by a parabolic PDE, not this mesh.
